purpose: Request independent code review with exact scope and closure of findings.

trigger: Get an independent review of my current implementation
Request a code review before final integration
Create a local review packet listing risks and tests
do_not_trigger: Publish an unapproved review comment to GitHub

preflight: Confirm exact baseline and changed head, owner of code and reviewer independence.

Read back review artifact including findings, disposition and SHA.

failure_modes: Reject self-review presented as independent assurance.
Unresolved blocking findings prevent final acceptance.
